name: JV / Co-Creation Partners

pain_points: JV risk: unclear ownership, unclear decision authority, unclear GTM

fit_logic.proceed: Partner brings distribution and a real commercial path, plus clear ownership terms
fit_logic.park: Decision authority, IP, and GTM are UNKNOWN
fit_logic.stop: JV terms unclear, no distribution commitment

what_they_sell: A new productised programme, typically recurring.
what_proof_means: Proof the product works, plus insight loops to improve the offer and defend pricing.
yoke_strengths: Rapid MVP foundation + proof loop + ability to iterate without rebuild
yoke_weaknesses: If JV decision rights, IP, or revenue model are unclear. This becomes slow politics.

messaging.value_proposition: Yoke enables JV partners to launch co-created products fast—with built-in proof and iteration capability.
messaging.elevator_pitch: JV products fail when build is slow and ownership unclear. Yoke provides rapid MVP foundation with shared proof—so partners can launch and iterate together.

two_lever_framing.lever_a: Increase JV product success with proof and iteration
two_lever_framing.lever_b: Reduce build time and partnership friction
